data.title: Template immutable-release preflight
data.description: Review fail-closed organization-enforced immutable-release checks before candidate preparation or publication.

data.reason: BLOCK: both new immutable-release preflights call GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/immutable-releases with github.token, but GitHub documents that endpoint as requiring repository Administration: read. Administration is not an available GITHUB_TOKEN workflow permission. prepare grants only contents: read; publish grants actions/artifact-metadata/attestations/contents/id-token, so neither token can authorize this query. The shell test fails closed on the resulting API error, which means every legitimate candidate preparation and publication is blocked even when the live policy returns enabled=true and enforced_by_owner=true to an admin token. Keep the early fail-closed placement, but obtain the policy evidence through an authorized admin-read mechanism outside GITHUB_TOKEN (or redesign the preflight around evidence the scoped token can read) without introducing a long-lived secret. actionlint and diff check pass; candidate identity, exact digest/file-set checks, no-rebuild transaction, attestation subject, and immutable publish/readback code are otherwise preserved.

LGTM after correction: the impossible github.token Administration API calls are removed, and prepare-release is byte-identical to the approved base. publish-release adds only a required boolean immutable_releases_verified dispatch input and an early test inside the protected release job. The input explicitly records the release approver's fresh admin API readback of enabled=true and enforced_by_owner=true; false/omitted values fail before candidate identity checks, artifact download, draft creation, attestation, tag, or publication. No admin token or long-lived secret is introduced. Fresh admin readback is currently true/true. actionlint and diff check pass. Existing least-privilege permissions, main/source/candidate-run identity binding, exact artifact digests/file set, no-rebuild transaction, exact attestation subject, burned-version checks, and immutable release readback remain byte-for-byte preserved outside the new gate.
